item.title: Home Assistant 2027.10 - 6 October 2027
item.description:
Home Assistant 2027.10 removes 3 APIs. 276 HACS custom integrations in the catalogue still use them.

What is being removed

  • DeviceEntry.config_entries: DeviceEntry.config_entries is deprecated; use DeviceEntry.config_entry_id instead. A custom integration reading it logs a warning from Home Assistant Core 2026.10, and 'the properties remain available to custom integrations until Home Assistant Core 2027.10, two releases later than the 2027.8 given in the earlier post.' Detected only where the receiver is proven to be a device entry, including a deleted or child device (a registry lookup, an annotation, or the async_remove_config_entry_device contract); hass.config_entries is never flagged. Reading the property on a synthesized composite device is exempt and does not report, but a deleted device and a child device are never composites, so every read on one of those reports. Used by 260 integrations. Logs a warning from Home Assistant 2026.10 (October 2026). source
  • DeviceEntry.primary_config_entry: DeviceEntry.primary_config_entry and DeviceEntry.config_entries_subentries are deprecated; use DeviceEntry.config_entry_id and DeviceEntry.config_subentry_id instead. A custom integration reading either logs a warning from Home Assistant Core 2026.10, and 'the properties remain available to custom integrations until Home Assistant Core 2027.10, two releases later than the 2027.8 given in the earlier post.' Devices are restricted to a single config entry. Reading them on a synthesized composite device is exempt and does not report. Used by 22 integrations. Logs a warning from Home Assistant 2026.10 (October 2026). source
  • modbus.get_hub: Calls modbus.get_hub. 'As of Home Assistant Core 2026.10, modbus.get_hub is deprecated. It will be removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.10. Custom integrations that call it get a warning in the log until then, and stop working after that.' The replacement is async_get_unit, and 'This is not a one-to-one swap.' Your config flow has to collect the host, port and unit id the user used to write in the YAML hub. Used by 1 integration. Logs a warning from Home Assistant 2026.10 (October 2026). source

item.title: Home Assistant 2027.9 - 1 September 2027
item.description:
Home Assistant 2027.9 removes 5 APIs. 132 HACS custom integrations in the catalogue still use them.

What is being removed

  • default_manufacturer: Passes default_manufacturer to DeviceInfo or DeviceRegistry.async_get_or_create. 'The default_manufacturer, default_model and default_name members of DeviceInfo are deprecated. Pass the plain manufacturer, model and name fields instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.9. Only the DeviceInfo(...) and async_get_or_create(...) call forms are matched; a plain dict literal {"default_manufacturer": ...} is not, because nothing in the file proves it is device info. Used by 3 integrations. source
  • default_model: Passes default_model to DeviceInfo or DeviceRegistry.async_get_or_create. 'The default_manufacturer, default_model and default_name members of DeviceInfo are deprecated. Pass the plain manufacturer, model and name fields instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.9. Only the DeviceInfo(...) and async_get_or_create(...) call forms are matched; a plain dict literal {"default_model": ...} is not, because nothing in the file proves it is device info. Used by 2 integrations. source
  • default_name: Passes default_name to DeviceInfo or DeviceRegistry.async_get_or_create. 'The default_manufacturer, default_model and default_name members of DeviceInfo are deprecated. Pass the plain manufacturer, model and name fields instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.9. Device trackers are the common case: pass name instead. Only the DeviceInfo(...) and async_get_or_create(...) call forms are matched; a plain dict literal {"default_name": ...} is not, because nothing in the file proves it is device info. Used by 5 integrations. source
  • DeviceRegistry.deleted_devices: Reads DeviceRegistry.deleted_devices. 'deleted_devices is an internal implementation detail of the device registry, and the whole attribute is now deprecated -- there is no supported public use. Accessing it in any way is deprecated.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.9. There is no replacement: a deleted device is registry bookkeeping, so the read has to go. Reported only where the receiver is proven to be a DeviceRegistry. Used by 4 integrations. source
  • DeviceRegistry.devices: Uses DeviceRegistry.devices as a mapping. 'Using it as a mapping -- subscription, .get(), .values(), .keys(), or membership by device id (device_id in registry.devices) -- is deprecated.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.9. Iterating the same attribute still works and is not reported: for device in registry.devices, len(registry.devices) and value membership (device_entry in registry.devices) are the supported uses. For a lookup by id call registry.async_get(device_id), or use async_entries_for_config_entry and the other helpers. Reported only where the receiver is proven to be a DeviceRegistry, so a coordinator's own .devices dict is never flagged. Used by 123 integrations. source

item.title: Home Assistant 2027.8 - 4 August 2027
item.description:
Home Assistant 2027.8 removes 19 APIs. 691 HACS custom integrations in the catalogue still use them.

What is being removed

  • async_device_info_to_link_from_device_id: calls async_device_info_to_link_from_device_id, which is deprecated and always returns None: a device_info carrying another device's identifiers implicitly added the caller's config entry to that device, which a single-config-entry device can't represent. Set entity.device_entry to the target device instead. Used by 2 integrations. source
  • async_device_info_to_link_from_entity: calls async_device_info_to_link_from_entity, which is deprecated and always returns None: a device_info carrying another device's identifiers implicitly added the caller's config entry to that device, which a single-config-entry device can't represent. Set entity.device_entry = async_entity_id_to_device(hass, source_entity_id) instead. Used by 1 integration. source
  • async_handle_source_entity_changes(add_helper_config_entry_to_device=...: calls async_handle_source_entity_changes with add_helper_config_entry_to_device, which no longer has any effect. Used by 1 integration. source
  • async_remove_helper_config_entry_from_source_device: homeassistant.helpers.helper_integration.async_remove_helper_devices. Used by 6 integrations. source
  • async_remove_stale_devices_links_keep_current_device: calls async_remove_stale_devices_links_keep_current_device, which is deprecated and does nothing: a device belongs to a single config entry, so a helper no longer adds its config entry to another device. Call homeassistant.helpers.helper_integration.async_remove_helper_devices with remove_all_devices=True instead. Used by 3 integrations. source
  • async_remove_stale_devices_links_keep_entity_device: calls async_remove_stale_devices_links_keep_entity_device, which is deprecated and does nothing: a device belongs to a single config entry, so a helper no longer adds its config entry to the source device. Call homeassistant.helpers.helper_integration.async_remove_helper_devices with remove_all_devices=True instead. Used by 1 integration. source
  • ATTR_VIA_DEVICE: ATTR_VIA_DEVICE imported from homeassistant.const is deprecated and is removed in Home Assistant 2027.8. Import it from via_device instead. Used by 4 integrations. source
  • CONCENTRATION_GRAMS_PER_CUBIC_METER: CONCENTRATION_GRAMS_PER_CUBIC_METER imported from homeassistant.const is deprecated and is removed in Home Assistant 2027.8. Used by 1 integration. source
  • CONCENTRATION_MICROGRAMS_PER_CUBIC_METER: CONCENTRATION_MICROGRAMS_PER_CUBIC_METER imported from homeassistant.const is deprecated and is removed in Home Assistant 2027.8. Used by 69 integrations. source
  • CONCENTRATION_MILLIGRAMS_PER_CUBIC_METER: CONCENTRATION_MILLIGRAMS_PER_CUBIC_METER imported from homeassistant.const is deprecated and is removed in Home Assistant 2027.8. Used by 13 integrations. source
  • CONCENTRATION_PARTS_PER_BILLION: CONCENTRATION_PARTS_PER_BILLION imported from homeassistant.const is deprecated and is removed in Home Assistant 2027.8. Used by 17 integrations. source
  • CONCENTRATION_PARTS_PER_CUBIC_METER: CONCENTRATION_PARTS_PER_CUBIC_METER imported from homeassistant.const is deprecated and is removed in Home Assistant 2027.8. Import it from p/m³ instead. Used by 1 integration. source
  • CONCENTRATION_PARTS_PER_MILLION: CONCENTRATION_PARTS_PER_MILLION imported from homeassistant.const is deprecated and is removed in Home Assistant 2027.8. Used by 83 integrations. source
  • via_device: DeviceInfo['via_device'] and DeviceRegistry.async_get_or_create(via_device=...) are deprecated -- 'Deprecated, use via_device_id instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8. Used by 171 integrations. source
  • DeviceRegistry.async_get_device: DeviceRegistry.async_get_device() is deprecated -- 'Identifiers and connections are only unique per config entry.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8; use async_get_device_by_identifier() or async_get_device_by_connection(). Used by 405 integrations. source
  • config_entries (device registry WebSocket field): Reads the config_entries field of a device registry WebSocket result. The replacements are config_entry_id and config_subentry_id; the old fields 'are kept for backwards compatibility and are deprecated; they are scheduled for removal in Home Assistant Core 2027.8.' Until then the old field is derived from the new one, so nothing is broken today. The WebSocket fields keep this date: the move to 2027.10 announced on 2026-09-15 covers the Python DeviceEntry properties only, and that post states the WebSocket API is unaffected. Used by 16 integrations. source
  • config_entries_subentries (device registry WebSocket field): Reads the config_entries_subentries field of a device registry WebSocket result, removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8. Use config_subentry_id (and config_entry_id) instead; the old field is derived from them during the deprecation period. The WebSocket fields keep this date: the move to 2027.10 announced on 2026-09-15 covers the Python DeviceEntry properties only, and that post states the WebSocket API is unaffected. Used by 1 integration. source
  • DeviceRegistry.async_update_device(add_config_entry_id=...): 'The add_config_entry_id, add_config_subentry_id, remove_config_entry_id and remove_config_subentry_id parameters are all deprecated.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8; use new_config_entry_id / new_config_subentry_id. Used by 122 integrations. source
  • primary_config_entry (device registry WebSocket field): Reads the primary_config_entry field of a device registry WebSocket result, removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8. Use config_entry_id instead; a device now belongs to exactly one config entry, so they are the same value. The WebSocket fields keep this date: the move to 2027.10 announced on 2026-09-15 covers the Python DeviceEntry properties only, and that post states the WebSocket API is unaffected.
